inputs: options-flow-feed-lab.lean=call-heavy (leaning bullish); tickers=12; contractsFlagged=610; callFraction=0.6977; topPrint=MSFT 485C $2.6M on 4.57x OI
bench.px=764.77; pctFrom52wHigh=-1.68; maStack=bull-stack; ma50Dist=1.76; ma200Dist=8.48; mom126=11.52
items.method: Cross-read the option-flow premium lean and its most-unusual print against the prior window's lean to detect a directional flip, then test whether the market-heatmap breadth percentage confirms or contradicts that lean versus the 60% threshold, and overlay the benchmark's distance from its 52-week high and moving-average stack, the VIX band and the intraday session type and VWAP, to judge whether a bullish premium turn is being backed by broad participation or is leaning into a narrow, compressed tape.
items.note: The genuinely new feature this window is that option premium has flipped: last window the tape was put-heavy and defensive, and now it reads call-heavy and leaning bullish, with the call-premium fraction at 0.70 across 12 tickers and 610 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days; the single most-unusual print is an MSFT 485 call at $2.6M on 4.6x its open interest. Yet the breadth underneath has not confirmed that lean — only 29.99% of the 134 market-heatmap constituents are positive on the day, a 30.01-point shortfall below the 60% broad-participation line — while SPY holds near 764.77, about 1.68% under its 52-week high, in a bull-stacked regime (50-day distance +1.76%, 200-day +8.48%, 126-day momentum +11.52%) and VIX eases to 15.44. So premium is turning optimistic into a still-narrow, still-compressed tape, and the intraday session is a balanced range-day under mixed control with VWAP 764.99. Watch whether breadth reclaims above the 60% line to validate the bullish premium lean; the risk-on read is undercut on a daily close below 760.00 on SPY, which would resolve the narrow top downward while volatility is still cheap.
items.title: SPY's hedged put-heavy tape flipped call-heavy this window even as daily breadth stayed pinned near 30% and VIX eased to 15.44 — a narrow tape now leaning bullish in premium

inputs: options-structure-lab.regime=negative dealer gamma; flip=765.57; callWall=770; putWall=760; expectedMove=3.81; spot=764.72
options-structure-lab.priorWindow=spot 762.6 below the 765 put wall; expectedMove 8.21; flip 765.51
items.method: Read the options-structure gamma sign, flip and wall levels against current benchmark spot, compare the wall-versus-spot geometry and the expected-move width to the prior window to detect compression or expansion, confirm the dealer scenario and conviction from the gamma playbook, then overlay the intraday session type and VWAP and the VIX band, to judge whether a spot that has reclaimed back inside the walls with a narrowing band is coiling to stabilise or merely pausing before the next break.
items.note: The new structural feature this window is a re-coil: last window spot had slipped below the near put wall in negative gamma with a wide plus or minus 8.21 expected move, and now SPY near 764.72 has climbed back between the walls — put wall 760, call wall 770 — with the front expected move compressed to plus or minus 3.81, so the modelled range has tightened to roughly 760.9 to 768.5. Signed dealer gamma is still negative and spot still sits just under the 765.57 flip, so the market has recovered into the corridor but has not yet reclaimed the level that would flip dealer hedging supportive. The gamma playbook still reads range-break-watch with patient conviction, and the intraday auction is a balanced range-day under mixed control with VWAP 764.99, while VIX at 15.44 keeps the band calm. This is a structure that stepped down last window and has coiled back to the middle: watch a clean reclaim above the 765.57 flip as the trigger that relieves the corridor upward, whereas the constructive read is invalidated on a sustained daily close below 760.00 on SPY, which loses the put wall in short gamma and reopens downside toward the lower strikes.
items.title: SPY spot near 764.72 has reclaimed back inside the 760/770 dealer walls and the front expected-move band roughly halved to ±3.81 from ±8.21 — a re-coil after last window's break beneath the wall

inputs: sector-research-lab.into=XLE (Leading, accel +4.42); out=XLF (Weakening, accel +1.55); leader=XLV (Leading); benchmark=SPY; count=11

real-assets-lab.drivers=xle63:9.0; xli63:5.93; btc63:21.31; gld63:1.24; dbc63:1.72; goldSilverRatio63:11.72; breadth:50
items.method: Cross-read the equity sector rotation's into/out legs and their acceleration against the prior window to detect a change in the leadership tilt, then set that tilt against the real-assets per-vehicle scores and the 63-day driver block (energy and industrial equity proxies, crypto, gold and the gold/silver ratio), and overlay the benchmark regime and VIX, to judge whether equity leadership and the real-asset drivers are converging on the same cyclical read or still diverging.
items.note: The genuinely new cross-tool feature is a convergence: last window equity sector rotation leaned defensive into utilities (XLU) while the real-asset complex read risk-on, a divergence; this window the equity rotation has moved into energy — XLE (Leading, accel +4.42) as XLF weakens (accel +1.55), XLV still Leading — which now agrees with the real-asset driver block rather than opposing it. Underneath, real assets stayed risk-on and broadened: ETH-USD leads at 73.6/100 and BTC-USD 71 are both uptrends, industrial copper CPER 63.6, PDBC 62.4 and DBC 62.2 hold firm, gold GLD firmed to 49.4 and IBIT jumped to 60.4 from the low-50s, while silver SLV 23.3 stays weak and oil USO 45.5 is mixed; 14 vehicles scored on a swing horizon. The 63-day driver block reads cyclical — energy-equity proxy +9.0 and industrial-equity +5.93 with the bitcoin proxy +21.31 against a gold proxy of only +1.24 and a broad-commodity proxy +1.72, and a gold-versus-silver ratio proxy of +11.72. So equity leadership has rotated toward the same cyclical energy the real-asset drivers favour. Watch whether energy and cyclical leadership persists to confirm the risk-on convergence; the read is undercut on a daily close below 760.00 on SPY, which would pull the convergence back toward caution.
items.title: Equity sector rotation shifted from defensive utilities to cyclical energy (into XLE) this window, now agreeing with a risk-on real-asset driver block where IBIT jumped to 60.4 and gold GLD firmed to 49.4
